reads only WorldVariables.get(world).datapack; writes planet_sel_data, gravity_data, friction_data, projection_list of the same WorldVariables (a sync after each) and runs the collision, light source, render sequence and dimensional data procedures on the same level
three collision maps built from the datapack list alone
the light source and opaque object maps built from the datapack list alone
the render, position, skybox and sky object maps built from the datapack list and the two maps made just before
the dimension type and dimensional data maps built from the datapack list alone
at a login: gravity and friction rebuilt from the datapack list by the formula Initialiseregistry uses; no other per-level variable
at a level load: a new datapack list, then Initialiseregistry (the list never changes without it)
the saved variables as written by save
save: every per-level variable (what the comparison of the first three dimensions reads)
